treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark for the avoidance of double taxation (2000, as amended by Protocol 2009; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Date of Conclusion: 3 July 2000 Entry into Force: 22 December 2000 Effective Date: 1 January 2001. Art. 29(2)(b): in Denmark: in respect of taxes for the income year beginning on or after 1 January 2001 and subsequent income years
source_title: IRAS consolidated text: Singapore-Denmark DTA (ratified)(MLI) (1 Dec 2021 upload), incl. Annex A MLI effects and Annex B 2009 Protocol

rates.quote: (a) 0 percent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 percent of the capital of the company paying the dividends where such holding is being possessed for an uninterrupted period of no less than one year and the dividends are declared within that period;
(c) 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ... (Annex A para 5(c)(i): taxes withheld at source ... on or after 1 January 2020)

notes: Dividend 0% tier is expressed as a 0 percent cap (not 'taxable only'): >=25% direct holding for an uninterrupted period of no less than one year, dividends declared within that period. Not modelled: 5% for dividends to pension funds (Art. 10(2)(b)); interest on loans granted/guaranteed/insured by the Government (incl. ECICS / Eksport Kredit Fonden) taxable only in residence State (Art. 11(7)). Valid_from per Danish effective date (income year beginning on/after 1 Jan 2001); Singapore side YA 2002. 2009 Protocol amends EOI only. MLI Art. 8 not applied.
